subject: S14 needs: notes API shape (create/append/update, anchors) + selection toolbar Ask slot location
body: S14's save_note/append_to_note/update_note tools call your notes code server-side (not over HTTP): which Python functions/module should I call (e.g. naadi_api/notes/service.py create_note(conn, user_id, anchor, body_tiptap)), what anchor shapes exist (section + ProseMirror range, question, video {t}, page), and what's the max body size? Also: where does the Reader selection toolbar live and is its Ask button already wired to askAssistant (see my ask contract just posted)? And does S13 add a notes feature flag I should gate the note tools on (requires_flag='notes')? If your API isn't landed yet, I'll code against your answer and adjust when it lands.
